phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Scoped the project, chose tools, inventoried the host, stood up this dashboard.

steps.label: Decide repo visibility, dashboard access, dotfiles tool, droppdd platform

phases.title: Git + GitHub
phases.summary: Local git identity, SSH key, and GitHub CLI auth so every host can push/pull without passwords.

steps.label: Set global git identity (noreply email for privacy)
Register SSH key with GitHub via gh

phases.title: tmux
phases.summary: Sane, boring, widely-recognized tmux config: sensible defaults, mouse on, readable status line, session persistence.

steps.label: Verify session survives detach/reattach and reboot (continuum)

phases.title: Fish shell
phases.summary: Fish as the default interactive shell, kept close to CachyOS defaults plus a small, standard plugin set via fisher.

phases.title: Bitwarden + Bitwarden CLI
phases.summary: Vault access from the terminal for secrets (never stored in git).

phases.title: chezmoi dotfiles
phases.summary: One source of truth for fish/tmux config, applied identically on box and the MacBook.

steps.label: chezmoi source dir symlinked to dotfiles/ and applied
Document `chezmoi init --apply` bootstrap for a brand-new host

phases.title: Dashboard hosting (Tailscale)
phases.summary: Serve this dashboard privately over the tailnet — reachable from box and the MacBook, never public. Live at https://box.tail2b3f17.ts.net/

steps.label: systemd --user unit serving dashboard/ over localhost (+ linger enabled)
tailscale serve to publish it on the tailnet only
Verify reachable from MacBook via tailnet

phases.title: droppdd (validation project)
phases.summary: Aggressive fitness/coaching app (keto, OMAD, guided workouts, AI meal planning) — scaffolded using everything above, proving the toolchain end to end. github.com/nunchimangchi-dev/droppdd

steps.label: Next.js scaffold + repo + CI lint workflow
Push to GitHub via SSH (no password prompt)

decisions.title: skyrise repo is public
decisions.why: Concrete, current infra/dotfiles work is the resume signal; secrets never live in git so public is safe.

decisions.title: Dashboard is Tailscale-only
decisions.why: Personal build log has no reason to be internet-facing; tailnet already includes box, phone, and the MacBook.

decisions.title: chezmoi over stow/plain script
decisions.why: Needs to reconcile real Linux/macOS differences (paths, package managers) across two hosts with one source of truth.

decisions.title: Git commit email is GitHub's noreply address
decisions.why: Standard privacy practice — keeps the real iCloud address out of public commit metadata.

decisions.title: droppdd starts as a Next.js web app
decisions.why: Fastest path to something usable on a phone browser today; mobile app shell can wrap it later if needed.

decisions.title: MagicDNS short hostname deferred
decisions.why: Would need a systemd-resolved/NetworkManager fix, and Tailscale's auto-cert only covers the full .ts.net name anyway, so a short name would break HTTPS. Not worth it yet — full URL works fine.

decisions.title: Reboot verification confirmed full auto-recovery
decisions.why: Rebooted box and checked the dashboard service, tailscale serve, and tmux-continuum boot-restore against docs/POST-REBOOT-CHECKLIST.md — all came back with zero manual steps, closing out the tmux phase.
